data_product_description: This dashboard lets ICBs and local health economies compare controlled drug prescribing across England, showing variation and outliers. It supports safe prescribing by showing controlled drug use compared to overall prescribing, helping spot areas needing review.
data_product_overview:

Note that your browser may give you warning that this is part of a data breach. As this is a publicly available user name and password you do not need to take any action and can login using the provided generic user ID and password.

## About this dashboard
Controlled drugs require stringent monitoring due to their potential for misuse and harm. The Controlled Drugs Comparators Dashboard in ePACT2 has been developed to highlight variation in prescribing of controlled drugs across England. It enables ICBs and local health economies to benchmark prescribing against national and regional averages, identify outliers, and review compliance with safety standards.

The dashboard shows the prescribing of specific controlled drugs by class relative to the prescribing of 1000 items in that class.
